project.title: Dextryx Images
project.tagline: A Rust-native GPUI desktop image application with a macOS-first production target.

summary.short: dxtr_imgs is the Rust-native desktop implementation of Dextryx Images, using GPUI with a local-first catalog model and direct Rust image-engine integration.
summary.long: The current M1 milestone provides a native file dialog, direct raw-engine image path, owned RGBA rendering in GPUI, common raster previews, embedded-JPEG RAW previews, Fit, 1:1, bounded zoom, pan, and trackpad or Cmd-scroll zoom. Real sensor RAW demosaic is intentionally out of scope for this milestone.

highlights: Raster and embedded-JPEG RAW preview viewport
